answer: Temporal Terrace Admission: each agent’s request inter-arrival times are mapped onto a rolling trellis of per-role cadence bands (bounded burstiness, stable phase, low cross-correlation). To graduate a multi-epoch voyage, an identity must sustain independent traffic across each terrace level; synchronized cohorts or burst-only agents fail the trellis. Attacker cost: operating every sybil continuously through all epochs with de-correlated schedules, real latency/compute, and coordination overhead—short bursts or shared timing patterns are rejected.
